title: South Florida Weekend Guide: Oct. 16 to 18
igCaption:
Food, music, a walk, and Halloween plans for South Florida this weekend.
Oct. 16 to 18, South Florida, prices vary

Sources: WPEC, TAPinto, Miami New Times, The Palm Beach Post

#MiamiEvents #SouthFlorida #WeekendGuide #ThingsToDo

scenes.text: Need a South Florida plan this weekend? Start with food in West Palm, then music, a walk, and Halloween clues.
Taste of West Palm Beach is set for CityPlace. The food festival was in the local news Friday, Oct. 16.

scenes.text: The Broward County Walk to End Alzheimer’s is set for Dec. 5 at Nova Southeastern University.
scenes.caption: The Broward County Walk to End Alzheimer’s is set for Dec. 5 at Nova Southeastern University.

scenes.text: For live music, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina takes over Kaseya Center Saturday at 8 p.m. Enrique Santos hosts, with Anuel AA, Myke Towers, Farruko, Manuel Turizo, and Greeicy on the bill. If you're at Kaseya Center, open NEAR and see who's around.

scenes.text: For Halloween plans, the Kimpton Surfcomber has a murder mystery dinner Saturday at 8 p.m. Guests get assigned character roles, follow clues, and sit down to three courses with craft cocktails.

scenes.text: Which one would you actually do this weekend? South Florida weekends are full of faces you pass on the way to the next stop, and NEAR is what turns that brief crossing into a name.
